from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric extracted from a single company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the report belongs to")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of '归属于母公司所有者的综合收益总额' extracted from the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this financial data, e.g., 2024 Q1")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit used in the report, e.g., 元")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed financial records from the document being processed."""
    financial_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
